evidence.quote: But how will others access, run, and explore them?

If, in 20 years, all other execution technology fails, these are likely to still provide a readable archival record, and with a full dependences list, future users are more likely to be able to recreate the compute environment.
You can also use Nbviewer ( https://nbviewer.jupyter.org/ ) to provide static views of your executed notebook online without needing to convert it to a PDF/HTML document first.
In both cases, you can point collaborators to a URL where they can read through your notebook online.
